protocol.description: Default protocol used when connecting (ftp, ftps, sftp, http, https)

ftp_proxy.description: FTP proxy host:port; empty string disables proxy

ftp_user.description: Default username used for anonymous or basic FTP logins

ftp_passive.description: Enable or disable passive FTP mode

locale.description: Locale used for message translation and character encoding (e.g., en_US.UTF-8)

file_charset.description: Character encoding used for local filenames and directory listings

net_max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed operations (0 = unlimited)

net_socket_buffer.description: Size of network socket buffer in bytes

ssl_verify_certificate.description: Enable or disable SSL certificate verification (required for secure connections)

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle file for SSL verification

mirror_parallel.description: Maximum number of parallel transfers during mirroring

mirror_parallel_min_size.description: Minimum file size (bytes) to trigger parallel transfer

xfer_log.description: Path to transfer log file (empty = no log)

xfer_log_syslog.description: Enable logging of transfers to syslog

xfer_log_time_format.description: Format string for timestamps in log entries

mirror_include_patterns.description: List of shell-style glob patterns for files to always include during mirroring

mirror_exclude_patterns.description: List of shell-style glob patterns for files to always exclude during mirroring

mirror_include_regex_patterns.description: List of POSIX extended regex patterns for files to always include

mirror_exclude_regex_patterns.description: List of POSIX extended regex patterns for files to always exclude

aliases.description: List of user-defined command aliases for convenience
